text: Managing a team well requires several important skills. First, clear communication is essential, because team members need to understand their tasks and goals. A good manager also knows how to delegate work effectively, giving each person responsibilities that match their strengths. Regular feedback helps employees improve and feel valued. Motivation is another key factor, and simple things like praising good work can make a big difference. Finally, managers must be ready to handle conflict resolution calmly when disagreements arise. By combining these skills, a manager can build a positive, productive team where everyone feels respected and supported.
